profile.subtitleJa: 律法の書・主の命令の受け手として名が挙げられる。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記下14:6は、子の罪で父を、父の罪で子を処刑しないようにという主の命令を「モーセの律法の書」に結び付けます。
profile.identityNoteJa: この書ではモーセ本人の新たな行動ではなく、彼に結び付けられた律法や命令への言及です。

facts.textJa: ヒゼキヤは、モーセが造った青銅の蛇を砕きました。
ヒゼキヤは主に従い、主がモーセに命じた戒めを守ったと記されます。
イスラエルの民は、主の僕モーセが命じた契約と教えに背いたと記されます。
主は、モーセを通して命じた律法に従うことをイスラエルに求めます。
ヨシヤはモーセの律法に従い、心を尽くして主に立ち返った王として記されます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.
For he joined with the LORD. He didn’t depart from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.
because they didn’t obey the LORD their God’s voice, but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear it or do it.

I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”

There was no king like him before him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.
